Bill.BriefDescription: Removing financial barriers to persons seeking vulnerable adult protection orders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to removing financial barriers to persons seekingvulnerable adult protection orders; and adding a new section to chapter74.34 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A public agency may not charge a fee for filing or service orprocess to petitioners seeking relief under this chapter. Petitionersmust be provided the necessary number of certified copies at no cost.
